textos.txt: Maria... you've arrived at the World of the Sample
Here, each environment represents a unique challenge — just like every type of sample in a chemistry laboratory
The forest is where everything begins: collection, planning, the doubt between what to take and what to leave behind
The ice freezes time... but also tests your patience and how well you preserve what was collected
In the desert, everything evaporates if it's not properly stored
In the sea, there are deep mysteries... and dangers as well
You may dive... but you will never run out of breath
And in the fiery cave, every mistake turns to ashes
Use your compass of knowledge and follow the signs of the standard
Are you ready for the journey?
Forest, ice, sea, desert, and fire... all this just to analyze a sample?
Or maybe each world reveals something about the process?
Exactly. Each element of this world represents a critical step: from collection to conservation, from storage to disposal
And remember: what matters is not only what you collect, but how you take care of it
Go with attention. Samples speak to those who know how to listen
Now go... and may your journey be precise, representative, and traceable
